display.purpose: Anchor statements: hero h1, contact close. One or two per view.

title.purpose: Project names in the work log; shift to Ember on hover.

body.purpose: Descriptions and prose, capped ~65-75ch. Lead paragraphs step up to 1.125rem.

label.purpose: Eyebrows and metadata; monospace, uppercase, wide-tracked.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: No box-shadow anywhere. Depth is tonal layering plus 1px hairline borders. Shadows are forbidden as a depth device.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover and focus color/border shifts on buttons, links, icons.

components.name: Icon Button
components.description: Ghost square icon link, used in the persistent top bar. Glyph turns Ember on hover.

components.name: Stack Chip
components.description: Quiet informational tech-stack tag. Pill with hairline border, mono text. No interactive state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid #2a2d34; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; color: #7c818c; }

components.name: Eyebrow Label
components.description: Signature section opener: a 24px Ember hairline followed by a mono, uppercase, wide-tracked Ember label. The visual 'prompt' that starts each block.
components.css: .ds-eyebrow { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', Menlo, monospace; font-size: 0.78rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #e9a86a; margin: 0; } .ds-eyebrow-rule { display: inline-block; width: 24px; height: 1px; background: rgba(233, 168, 106, 0.6); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Top-bar section link with the signature animated hairline underline (scaleX from left, also fires on focus).
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; color: #9ca0a6; text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 1px; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.44, 0, 0.56, 1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #f4f5f6; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); }

narrative.overview: A precise, honest record, not a brochure. A dark graphite canvas, structure drawn in hairlines instead of boxes, and a single warm signal (Ember) that appears only where it means something. Metadata is set in monospace and reads like log entries; work is numbered and listed, not packaged into cards. The personality is precise, understated, and honest; the emotional target is quietly impressive. It earns trust by not trying too hard, and every detail holds up under inspection.
keyCharacteristics: Dark graphite canvas with stepped tonal surfaces; depth from layering and hairlines, never shadows.
One warm accent (Ember), held to a tiny footprint and always semantic.
A strict Sans-for-prose / Mono-for-metadata split that does the work of an information hierarchy.
Editorial type scale: a few very large statements, everything else quiet.
Work presented as numbered logbook rows, not cards.
Motion is restraint plus one soft reveal; everything collapses cleanly under reduced-motion.

rules.name: The One Ember Rule
rules.body: The accent appears on no more than ~10% of any screen. Its rarity is the point: it is a signal, not a theme. If a second thing wants to be amber, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Tinted-Black Rule
rules.body: Never #000 and never #fff. The darkest surface is #0b0c0e and the lightest text is #f4f5f6. Every neutral is tinted cool toward the graphite hue.

rules.name: The Color-Plus-Partner Rule
rules.body: Ember never carries meaning alone. A non-color partner travels with it (position, icon, weight shift, the leading hairline) so meaning survives for color-blind readers.

rules.name: The Mono Metadata Rule
rules.body: Prose is Sans; metadata is Mono. Roles, dates, status, stack tags, eyebrows, terminal text, and the email are always monospace. This split is the information hierarchy.

rules.name: The Sparse-Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is rationed: at most one or two display-scale statements per view, surrounded by quiet. Its size is the emphasis.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is forbidden as a depth device. If something needs to read as elevated, step its background up one tonal surface and give it a hairline border.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Structure is drawn in 1px Line (#2a2d34) borders and never thicker as a decorative device. No 2px+ colored side-stripes.

rules.name: The No-Card Rule
rules.body: Don't reach for a card or modal by reflex. Work goes in bordered logbook grid rows; prefer inline progressive patterns over modals.

dos: Do keep Ember (#e9a86a) under ~10% of any screen and always semantic (link, prompt, status, focus, active).
Do build depth with tonal surfaces (#0b0c0e -> #131419 -> #1c1e24) and 1px Line (#2a2d34) hairlines.
Do set all metadata (roles, dates, status, stack, eyebrows, email) in Geist Mono and all prose in Geist Sans.
Do ration display type: one or two display-scale statements per view, surrounded by quiet.
Do pair every Ember signal with a non-color cue (icon, position, weight, the leading hairline).
Do give every interactive element a designed hover and a visible focus state (the 2px Ember ring), and collapse it all under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do hold the whole site to WCAG 2.2 AA, including contrast on the small mono metadata.
donts: Don't ship the generic developer-portfolio template: no animated skill bars, no uniform grid of identical project cards, no decorative gradient blob.
Don't drift toward the corporate SaaS landing page: no cream or pastel backgrounds, no soft rounded cards, no gentle gradients, no big-number hero-metric template.
Don't use box-shadow as a depth device; step a tonal surface and add a hairline instead.
Don't use pure #000 or #fff; the tinted graphite neutrals are the floor and ceiling.
Don't use background-clip: text gradient text, or any decorative gradient. Emphasis comes from scale and weight.
Don't introduce a second accent color or a third type family. One Ember, one Sans, one Mono.
Don't use a colored side-stripe (border-left/border-right > 1px) as an accent on any element.
Don't reach for a card or a modal by reflex. Prefer the bordered grid row and the inline progressive pattern.
